title: BACnet-uc IO point mapping (/lfs/cfg/io.json)
description: Binds hardware channels from the board IO catalog (devicetree node compatible "uc,io-channels") to BACnet objects. The firmware creates the objects at boot and on 'uc_node reload io', samples inputs into Present_Value and drives outputs from Present_Value.

channel.description: Catalog channel name, e.g. di0, do1, ai0, ao0.

type.description: BACnet object type. di -> binary-input|multi-state-input, do -> binary-output|binary-value, ai -> analog-input, ao -> analog-output|analog-value.

name.description: Object_Name; defaults to the channel name.

units.description: BACnet engineering unit text name as used by the BACnet stack, e.g. degrees-celsius, percent, volts, no-units.

scale.description: Analog: engineering = raw * scale + offset (ai raw = mV). ao: raw % = (PV - offset) / scale.

invert.description: Binary: invert polarity on top of the devicetree GPIO flags.
